body: Hi there! Thanks for the report. I've queued this for a reproduction check on Wails v3. We'll keep this open while we investigate.

Hi there! I couldn't reproduce this with the test below; that doesn't rule out the report. Thanks!

<details>
<summary>Test evidence</summary>

Tested master ([pinned source](https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/commit/d8f3336d53149059061558a39d58f65e5ee3e63f)). Each VM started from its clean test snapshot and ran offline.

Trigger: Run the real bindings sync entry point syncDirs(src, dst), which GenerateBindings invokes when Clean is active, with a populated temp generation directory containing the generated binding module paths (including internal/serviceV2.ts) that the report says could not be resolved, plus a pre-existing output directory, then measure whether every expected file resolves in the output directory immediately after syncDirs returns.

Expected: After syncDirs returns, every expected binding module path (including internal/serviceV2.ts) exists as a file in the output directory, and stale entries are removed, so an import resolver scanning the directory would find the imported module.

**macOS 26.6.2 ARM64 — not reproduced**

```text
go test -json -count=1 -timeout=90s -run ^TestWorkflowRepro$ ./internal/commands
ProductVersion:		26.6.2
BuildVersion:		25G83
go version go1.27.1 darwin/arm64
REPRO_OBSERVATION: positive control reached, src tree present, files=4
REPRO_OBSERVATION: syncDirs complete, dst entries missing=0 of 4
```

Scope: a Go package test against this pinned version, simulating the reported failure. It does not establish behavior in every release or exercise the GUI. Screenshots are not applicable. 

Revision selection: current public master. Results apply only to the pinned source and OS shown; an inferred version is not attributed to the reporter.

Independent evidence review agreed with these results.

</details>
